Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Cottage Grove for 2026, and here is what he found: 3 family events, 2 of them free. The season runs from December 3 (Hometown Holiday at City Hall with Santa, live reindeer, wagon rides and 25,000 lights) through December 13, with the Winter Wonderland no-school-day program on December 4 and the CPKC Holiday Train stop on December 13 at 5:15 pm. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
